title.en: Basic concepts of testing of hypothesis

hook.en: A court starts by assuming the accused is innocent and convicts only on strong evidence. A statistical test works the same way: we assume a null hypothesis and reject it only if the sample gives strong evidence against it.
hook.kn: ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಆರೋಪಿಯನ್ನು ನಿರಪರಾಧಿ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಿ, ಬಲವಾದ ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯವಿದ್ದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆಯನ್ನು ಊಹಿಸಿ, ಮಾದರಿ ಬಲವಾದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ನೀಡಿದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

objectives.en: Define null and alternative hypotheses, test statistic and critical region
Explain Type I and Type II errors, level of significance and power
Follow the steps of a test; one- and two-tailed tests

narration.en: A court starts by assuming the accused is innocent and convicts only on strong evidence. A statistical test works the same way: we assume a null hypothesis and reject it only if the sample gives strong evidence against it.
narration.kn: ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಆರೋಪಿಯನ್ನು ನಿರಪರಾಧಿ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಿ, ಬಲವಾದ ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯವಿದ್ದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆಯನ್ನು ಊಹಿಸಿ, ಮಾದರಿ ಬಲವಾದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ನೀಡಿದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

body.en: A statistical hypothesis is a statement about a population parameter. The null hypothesis $H_0$ is the hypothesis of no difference that is tested, e.g. $H_0: \mu = \mu_0$. The alternative $H_1$ is accepted when $H_0$ is rejected: $\mu \ne \mu_0$ (two-tailed), $\mu > \mu_0$ (right-tailed) or $\mu < \mu_0$ (left-tailed). Type I error: rejecting a true $H_0$, probability $\alpha$ (the level of significance). Type II error: accepting a false $H_0$, probability $\beta$. Power $= 1 - \beta$.
body.kn: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ H₀ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿಲ್ಲ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ; H₀ ತಿರಸ್ಕೃತವಾದಾಗ ಪರ್ಯಾಯ H₁ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ. ಮೊದಲ ಬಗೆಯ ದೋಷ: ಸತ್ಯ H₀ ತಿರಸ್ಕಾರ (α, ಮಹತ್ವದ ಮಟ್ಟ). ಎರಡನೇ ಬಗೆಯ ದೋಷ: ಸುಳ್ಳು H₀ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ (β). ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ 1 − β.

narration.en: The null hypothesis says there is no difference. If we reject a true null hypothesis we make a Type I error, with probability alpha, the level of significance. If we accept a false one we make a Type II error, with probability beta. One minus beta is the power of the test.
narration.kn: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ H₀ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿಲ್ಲ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ; H₀ ತಿರಸ್ಕೃತವಾದಾಗ ಪರ್ಯಾಯ H₁ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ. ಮೊದಲ ಬಗೆಯ ದೋಷ: ಸತ್ಯ H₀ ತಿರಸ್ಕಾರ (α, ಮಹತ್ವದ ಮಟ್ಟ). ಎರಡನೇ ಬಗೆಯ ದೋಷ: ಸುಳ್ಳು H₀ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ (β). ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ 1 − β.

narration.en: The teacher draws the five steps of a test as a flowchart and marks the two-tailed critical region on a normal curve.

say.en: Every test follows the same five steps. Let us draw them as a flowchart.
For a two-tailed test at 5 percent, the critical region is both tails beyond plus and minus 1.96.
If the calculated value falls in a tail, reject H nought. Otherwise there is no evidence against it.
Remember the four critical values for large samples.

body.en: The test statistic (e.g. $Z = \dfrac{t - E(t)}{SE(t)}$) is computed from the sample. The critical (rejection) region is the set of values of the test statistic for which $H_0$ is rejected; its boundary is the critical value. For large samples: two-tailed $|Z| > 1.96$ at 5% and $|Z| > 2.58$ at 1%; right-tailed $Z > 1.645$ (5%) or $Z > 2.33$ (1%); left-tailed $Z < -1.645$ or $Z < -2.33$.
body.kn: ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಸೂಚಿ Z = (t − E(t))/SE(t). H₀ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸುವ ಬೆಲೆಗಳ ಪ್ರದೇಶ ವಿಮರ್ಶಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರದೇಶ. ದ್ವಿಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ: 5% ಗೆ 1.96, 1% ಗೆ 2.58; ಏಕಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ: 1.645, 2.33.

narration.en: The test statistic (e.g. Z = dfract - E(t)SE(t)) is computed from the sample. The critical (rejection) region is the set of values of the test statistic for which H_0 is rejected; its boundary is the critical value. For large samples: two-tailed |Z| > 1.96 at 5% and |Z| > 2.58 at 1%; right-tailed Z > 1.645 (5%) or Z > 2.33 (1%); left-tailed Z < -1.645 or Z < -2.33.
narration.kn: ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಸೂಚಿ Z = (t − E(t))/SE(t). H₀ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸುವ ಬೆಲೆಗಳ ಪ್ರದೇಶ ವಿಮರ್ಶಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರದೇಶ. ದ್ವಿಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ: 5% ಗೆ 1.96, 1% ಗೆ 2.58; ಏಕಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ: 1.645, 2.33.

caption.en: Sampling distribution of Z under H₀ (yellow) and under H₁ (blue). Move the critical value c and the true shift d.

narration.en: The yellow curve is the test statistic when the null hypothesis is true; the blue one is when the true mean has shifted. Move the cut-off: alpha and beta change in opposite directions.

tryThis.en: Raise c: α falls, but what happens to β?
Keep c = 1.65 and increase d. Does the power rise?

problem.en: A coin is tossed 4 times to test H₀: p = ½ against H₁: p = ¾. H₀ is rejected if 4 heads appear. Find α, β and the power.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A coin is tossed 4 times to test H₀: p = ½ against H₁: p = ¾. H₀ is rejected if 4 heads appear. Find α, β and the power.

body.en: Type I is a false alarm (crying wolf when there is no wolf); Type II is a missed alarm (no cry when the wolf comes). α is the false-alarm rate.

narration.en: Type I vs Type II. Type I is a false alarm (crying wolf when there is no wolf); Type II is a missed alarm (no cry when the wolf comes). α is the false-alarm rate.

mnemonic.en: I = false alarm, II = missed alarm

points.en: H₀: no difference; H₁: what we accept if H₀ is rejected.
points.kn: H₀: ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿಲ್ಲ; H₀ ತಿರಸ್ಕೃತವಾದರೆ H₁ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ.

points.en: Type I error: reject a true H₀ (α); Type II: accept a false H₀ (β).
points.kn: ಮೊದಲ ದೋಷ: ಸತ್ಯ H₀ ತಿರಸ್ಕಾರ (α); ಎರಡನೇ ದೋಷ: ಸುಳ್ಳು H₀ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ (β).

homework.en: Write the general procedure for testing a hypothesis.

narration.en: Recap. H₀: no difference; H₁: what we accept if H₀ is rejected. Type I error: reject a true H₀ (α); Type II: accept a false H₀ (β). Power = 1 − β. Critical Z: 1.96 / 2.58 two-tailed; 1.645 / 2.33 one-tailed.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. H₀: ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿಲ್ಲ; H₀ ತಿರಸ್ಕೃತವಾದರೆ H₁ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ. ಮೊದಲ ದೋಷ: ಸತ್ಯ H₀ ತಿರಸ್ಕಾರ (α); ಎರಡನೇ ದೋಷ: ಸುಳ್ಳು H₀ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ (β). ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ = 1 − β. ವಿಮರ್ಶಾತ್ಮಕ Z: ದ್ವಿಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ 1.96 / 2.58; ಏಕಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ 1.645 / 2.33.
